verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֑רַח עַֽל־ עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ ‘al- ‘ă·lā·mō·wṯ šîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·nū ma·ḥă·seh wā·‘ōz ‘ez·rāh ḇə·ṣā·rō·wṯ nim·ṣā mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of the sons of Korah According to Alamoth A song God is our refuge and strength an ever-present . . . help in times of trouble
verses.literalPt: DEUS é o nosso refúgio e fortaleza, socorro bem presente na angústia.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן לֹא־ נִ֭ירָא בְּהָמִ֣יר אָ֑רֶץ וּבְמ֥וֹט הָ֝רִ֗ים בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lō- nî·rā bə·hā·mîr ’ā·reṣ ū·ḇə·mō·wṭ hā·rîm bə·lêḇ yam·mîm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . we will not fear though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas
verses.literalPt: Portanto não temeremos, ainda que a terra se mude, e ainda que os montes se transportem para o meio dos mares.

verses.original: יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ מֵימָ֑יו יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ־ הָרִ֖ים בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ye·hĕ·mū yeḥ·mə·rū mê·māw yir·‘ă·šū- hā·rîm bə·ḡa·’ă·wā·ṯōw se·lāh
verses.literal: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge Selah
verses.literalPt: Ainda que as águas rujam e se perturbem, ainda que os montes se abalem pela sua braveza. (Selá.)

verses.original: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.literal: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God the holy place where the Most High dwells
verses.literalPt: Há um rio cujas correntes alegram a cidade de Deus, o santuário das moradas do Altíssimo.

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־ תִּמּ֑וֹט יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים לִפְנ֥וֹת בֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·qir·bāh bal- tim·mō·wṭ ya‘·zə·re·hā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lip̄·nō·wṯ bō·qer
verses.literal: God is within her she will not be moved God will help her when morning dawns
verses.literalPt: Deus está no meio dela; não se abalará. Deus a ajudará, já ao romper da manhã.

verses.original: הָמ֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם מָ֣טוּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ תָּמ֥וּג אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·mū ḡō·w·yim mā·ṭū mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ nā·ṯan bə·qō·w·lōw tā·mūḡ ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Nations rage kingdoms crumble the earth melts when He lifts His voice
verses.literalPt: Os gentios se embraveceram; os reinos se moveram; ele levantou a sua voz e a terra se derreteu.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־ לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mā·nū miś·gāḇ- lā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts is with us the God of Jacob is our fortress Selah
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR dos Exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é o nosso refúgio. (Selá.)

verses.original: לְֽכוּ־ חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- ḥă·zū mip̄·‘ă·lō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer- śām šam·mō·wṯ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Come see the works of the LORD who brings devastation upon the earth
verses.literalPt: Vinde, contemplai as obras do SENHOR; que desolações tem feito na terra!

verses.original: מַשְׁבִּ֥ית מִלְחָמוֹת֮ עַד־ קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ קֶ֣שֶׁת יְ֭שַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת יִשְׂרֹ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: maš·bîṯ mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ qe·šeṯ yə·šab·bêr wə·qiṣ·ṣêṣ ḥă·nîṯ ‘ă·ḡā·lō·wṯ yiś·rōp̄ bā·’êš
verses.literal: He makes wars to cease throughout . . . the earth He breaks the bow and shatters the spear He burns the shields in the fire
verses.literalPt: Ele faz cessar as guerras até ao fim da terra; quebra o arco e corta a lança; queima os carros no fogo.

verses.original: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי־ אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: Be still and know that I am God I will be exalted among the nations I will be exalted over the earth
verses.literalPt: Aquietai-vos, e sabei que eu sou Deus; serei exaltado entre os gentios; serei exaltado sobre a terra.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־ לָ֝נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mā·nū miś·gāḇ- lā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts is with us the God of Jacob is our fortress Selah
verses.literalPt: O SENHOR dos Exércitos está conosco; o Deus de Jacó é o nosso refúgio. (Selá.)
